name: singlet_cross_species_cell_type_correspondence
title: Cross-species cell-type correspondence
description: Scores every cell type of a species-A atlas against every cell type of a species-B atlas over one-to-one orthologs, then reports best matches and conserved versus species-specific flags. The default method, metaneighbor, is a heuristic that needs no training; scanvi returns posterior label probabilities and samap suits distant metazoan atlases. Do not use it for within-species matching, for building the ortholog table (run cross-species ortholog assignment first), or when either atlas lacks cell-type labels. It writes only to dataset and never modifies the partner atlas.

dataset.description: Species-A dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI, or a workspace handle. Outputs are written here only.

label_key.description: Species-A obs column with cell-type labels.

source.description: Species-B .singlet path, URI or workspace handle.

label_key.description: Species-B obs column with cell-type labels.

method.description: Scorer. metaneighbor is the default heuristic; scanvi gives posterior probabilities.

conserved_threshold.description: Score at or above which a best match is flagged conserved; null writes no flags. Reciprocal top hits are always reported.

min_cells_per_type.description: Types with fewer cells in either atlas are excluded from scoring.

method_options.description: Options for the chosen method; each nested object applies only to the method it is named after.

auroc_candidate_threshold.description: AUROC above which a pair is a candidate; a documented within-study heuristic.

reciprocal_top_hit.description: Report reciprocal best matches as candidate conserved pairs.

dims.description: CCA dimensions 1 to dims used to find anchors.

max_features.description: Maximum features used for anchor scoring.

n_hidden.description: Hidden units per encoder and decoder layer.

n_latent.description: Latent dimension of the variational model.

seed.description: Random seed for scanvi and samap.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members for the same method instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the species-A dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example uns/cross_species_matrix_metaneighbor. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Summary keys: method, n_types_a, n_types_b, n_one_to_one_orthologs, n_reciprocal_top_hits, conserved_threshold, n_conserved, n_species_specific, warnings.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
